en.title: IRS online services spotlight: Taxpayers can get more done online
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service encouraged taxpayers to explore IRS.gov online tools that can help them quickly and securely take care of common tax tasks.

en.title: IRS reminder: Extension filers can use IRS Free File this summer
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service encouraged taxpayers who requested an extension to file their 2025 federal tax return as soon as possible.

en.title: IRS CEO meets with tax professionals at NY tax forum
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service reported on its engagement with taxpayers and representatives at the IRS Nationwide Tax Forum in New York.

es.title: Recordatorio del IRS: contribuyentes con prórrogas pueden usar Free File del IRS este verano
es.summary: El IRS alentó a los contribuyentes que solicitaron una prórroga a presentar su declaración federal de 2025 lo antes posible, en lugar de esperar hasta la fecha límite del 15 de octubre.
